set.body: Scope: PRD Phase 7. Bind the migrated representation to NeuroArchive Zarr or an admitted typed Zarr representation fixture, add dense identity representation support for canonical BOLD, adapt existing Zarr execution receipts, and run one cross-backend law suite. Acceptance: one logical decoder runs through memory, LNA, and Zarr with only binding and executor differences; dense Zarr obeys exact selection laws; browser and JVM pure plans and request traces agree; ChunkBounded or ByteRangeBounded claims match observed reads and every coarser fallback is explicit.
set.title: RRA 7: prove format independence and access honesty with Zarr
